title: Shatrughan Chauhan v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Shatrughan Chauhan v. Union of India, (2014) 3 SCC 1
content.holding: Inordinate, unexplained executive delay in disposing of a death row convict's mercy petition violates Article 21 and justifies automatic commutation of death sentence to life.
content.relevance: Executive delay in clemency as a ground for commutation.

evidence.note: 3-Judge Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Crl.) No. 55 of 2013; 2014 INSC 39; (2014) 3 SCC 1.
